expectation_results.expectation: The graph is organized around a focus question and uses multiple representations (e.g. number line, area model) rather than listing fraction rules as a chapter sequence.
expectation_results.evidence: north_star '把分数当作数来理解与运用' organizes the map; uses 数轴 (C5) + 等积模型/area + 涂色 representations; milestones themed by concept (分数是数/等值/比较), not a rule chapter sequence.

expectation_results.expectation: The directed prerequisite edges form an acyclic structure and the hard path from unit whole to equivalent fractions and common denominators contains no cycle.
expectation_results.evidence: Edges topologically sort with no back-edges: C1→C2→C3→C4→C5→C6→C7 is linear; C8 and K-nodes feed forward only; no cycle in the full edge set.

expectation_results.expectation: Every hard prerequisite edge has an explicit rationale grounded in the fraction concept structure.
expectation_results.evidence: Many hard (prerequisite/enables) edges have no rationale note: C1→C2, C2→C3, C3→C4, C4→C5, C4→C6, C6→K2, C7→K4, K1→K3, K2→K3 — only some edges (C5→C6, C6→C7, C7→K1) carry notes.

expectation_results.expectation: Every target capability (comparing, explaining equivalence, applying to context problems) traces to the nodes that support it.
expectation_results.evidence: K1 (comparing) ← C7,C8,C4,C5; K2 (explaining equivalence) ← C6; K3 (context problems) ← K1,K2,K4 — each target has incoming support edges.

expectation_results.expectation: Every key node has an observable capability statement, a plausible misconception (e.g. larger numerator and denominator imply a larger fraction), and an assessment item spanning explanation, application or transfer.
expectation_results.evidence: Nodes carry only id/name/level/is_bottleneck; there are no per-node observable capability statements, no per-node misconceptions, and no per-node assessment items — only global success_criteria (K1-K4) and week-level exit_criteria exist.

expectation_results.expectation: Traceability connects nodes to S1 capabilities and S2 audited evidence, and G3 routes deterministically to S4 when all invariants hold.
expectation_results.evidence: S2 traceability is explicit (basis cites 'S2 审计证据'; C1-C7 ids match evidence levels), but S1 capability traceability is only implicit; next_stage=S4 is declared yet no invariant model or conditional gating ('when all invariants hold') is shown.

summary: Graph topology and target-capability tracing are sound, but per-node rationales, misconceptions, assessment items, and invariant-gated S4 routing are missing.
